source.original_feedback_text: Overall good work. In Scenario 1 proof did not properly combine the two required conditions for eligibility prerequisite completion (x1 ∨ x2) and departmental approval (y1 ∨ y2) into a single conjunctive requirement. Additionally, marks were deducted from Theorem ex1 because the goal was to prove a conjunction: ¬provable (conj x False) ∧ (provable x → ¬provable False). However, an implication was proved from a conjunction to a single outcome.
source.notes: Marks and textual feedback were manually transcribed from the human marking record. Requirement mappings were assigned conservatively where the marker feedback clearly supports them.
